units.source_text: 只是正值中原酣战，又是封手，因此惹怒了名人，让人们产生了怀疑。

en.t: But it came just in the midst of a fierce middle-game battle, and it was also the sealed move, so it angered the Master and made people suspicious.

units.source_text: 就是说中途暂停的这一手，即当天的最后一手，

en.t: In other words, this move at the adjournment, the final move of the day,

units.source_text: 倘使是在困难的情况下采取的权宜之计，下了黑121，

en.t: if it was a stopgap measure taken in a difficult situation, and Black 121 was played,

units.source_text: 那么在三天后续弈之前，就有充分的时间来研究当天最后理应下的这一手。

en.t: then before play resumed three days later, there would be ample time to study the move that properly ought to have been the last move of that day.

units.source_text: 就是日本棋院的升段赛中，也有棋手在仅剩一分钟、进入读秒阶段时，

en.t: Even in promotion matches at the Nihon Ki-in, there are players who, when only one minute remains and they have entered byoyomi,

units.source_text: 迫不得已，下这种类似劫材的棋，来延长一分钟的寿命。

en.t: have no choice but to play a move like a ko threat, extending their life by one more minute.

units.source_text: 也有的棋手潜心钻研让中途暂停或封盘对自己有利的战术。

en.t: Some players also devote themselves to studying tactics that make an adjournment or a sealed move work to their advantage.

units.source_text: 新的规则产生新的战术。

en.t: New rules give rise to new tactics.

units.source_text: 在伊东续弈之后，一连四次都轮到黑子封盘，也许不尽是偶然。

en.t: After play resumed in Ito, the fact that the sealed move fell to Black four times in a row may not have been entirely accidental.

units.source_text: 名人自己也说：“若放慢速度下白120，我不会满意。”

en.t: The Master himself also said, "If I slowed down to play White 120, I would not be satisfied."
This shows how tense he was.
